response.overview: EVERY LIFE COUNTS follows four women as they ride Australia's first quad tandem bicycle 4,000 kilometres from Perth to Sydney to spark conversations about mental health and suicide. Over six weeks, they travel through regional towns, small communities and major cities, meeting Australians who share deeply personal stories of loss, resilience and hope.  Along the way, the documentary also explores the riders' own motivations, challenges and connections to the cause, revealing the power of conversation, human connection and the reminder that every life counts.
response.title: EVERY LIFE COUNTS
